newsitem.title: UK: Nine injured in blast at UK gasworks - police.
newsitem.headline: Nine injured in blast at UK gasworks - police.

text.p: At least nine people were injured, four of them seriously, in an explosion at a gasworks in Runcorn, northwest England, on Wednesday evening, emergency services said.
The injured were all employees at the gas works, who were working on a gas main when it exploded, officials said.
"It appears to be a genuine, unfortunate accident," said a police spokeswoman.
The gas works went up in flames and "was still burning out of control," a fire brigade spokesman said at around midnight.
Ten fire engines were called to the scene, the area was cordoned off and nearby houses evacuated.
